               <lb n="20b4"/> nas bkrol ba 'di | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7021">theg pa mchog gi rnor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs> kyis yang yang du bskul nas | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4066">btsun pa thogs med</rs> kyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5692">chos <lb n="20b5"/> rdzong</rs> du sbyar ba'o || 'dis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po bsgrub nus par gyur 1 ||</seg></TEI>
